title: Wagner & Lotz 2004 anterior AF exponential fit initial slope A

quantity.name: exponential fit initial slope A
quantity.definition: A in sigma = (A/B)(exp(B e) - 1), slope at origin

source.sample: 11 circumferential anterior AF strips (5 mm wide, 7 mm high, ~30 mm long) from L2-L3 to L4-L5 grade I-II discs of 6 autopsy spines

protocol.summary: Rectangular anterior AF specimens 5 x 7 x ~30 mm loaded circumferentially; soaked overnight in 0.15 M saline + protease inhibitors and tested submerged; nine-pin optical strain grid; preconditioning 10 cycles tension/compression (0.05 to -0.01 MPa) at ~0.002 /s; reference = zero-force state (no tare load); tension to 0.4 MPa at 0.0001 /s; re-preconditioned (5 cycles), then compression to -0.04 MPa at 0.0001 /s. Tension fitted per side with sigma = (A/B)(exp(B e) - 1) (A = slope at origin); compression fitted with a straight line.
how_to_simulate: Model a 5 x 7 x 30 mm anterior AF strip with circumferential loading, no tare load (reference = zero force)
Apply circumferential tension to 0.4 MPa and compression to -0.04 MPa at 0.0001 /s (quasi-static)
Report stress vs central optical strain; compute tangent modulus at 0.4 MPa and compressive slope

extraction.check_notes: Values from Results text (OCR dropped +- signs; checked: tangent at 0.4 MPa = A + B*0.4 = 0.447 + 12.76 = 13.2 MPa consistent with the fit form sigma=(A/B)(exp(Be)-1)).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
